history: Record round zero declaration, authority, inventory, holder, desired and observed states, exact command effect and final probe. Each retry begins with fresh probe and holder observation; prior effects remain recorded.

items.expect: Declaration, authority and service-entry files match digests.

onFail.instruction: Request exact missing or drifted service evidence.

items.expect: Pre-effect probe, pid and port holder are recorded and foreign owners remain untouched.

items.expect: Declaration, process, container and probe capabilities are available.

items.expect: Service row, desired state, authority and probe are complete.

items.expect: Service effect completion is known from fresh probe and holder observation.

onFail.instruction: Probe and inventory first; never blindly repeat start or stop.

stopWhen: Stop after two feedback rounds, repeated probe failure, missing approval, foreign holder, unavailable capability or unobservable uncertain effect. Done requires declared probe proof of the requested state.
